note: The run plays in place on a loop (x and y all 0, no path); it only carries the fps the page puts in the Run fps box. The Rogue's six frames are ONE step (contact, early stance, mid stance, passing, push-off, flight; the next loop repeats the same step), so 11 fps gives about 1.8 steps a second like the warrior's 9 fps with five frames. The planted boot slides back about 57 px a frame (11% of the frame width), which is what the ground should do (BG_STEP.rogue 12).
